SearchFetch Fixture Article

This is a benign local fixture page used to verify that web_fetch renders a normal content page to clean markdown quickly, with no local-LLM call on the fast path. It contains several paragraphs of real text so that the pruning and BM25 filters have meaningful content to work on.

Section One

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pangrams are sentences that use every letter of the alphabet at least once and make a good filler for testing text extraction and markdown conversion pipelines.

Section Two: Pricing and Launch

The product launches in June 2026 and is priced at 42 credits per month. This sentence exists so a BM25 query like "pricing and launch date" has an obvious relevant chunk to rank highly.
